admission: Targeted primary-source reading and repository-product inspection; no full literature review. External full texts remain external. All scenario prices and audience values are assumptions.

brief.title: Terluna: Lunar Sports, Professional Leagues, and Their Economic Potential
brief.kind: Exported working synthesis, supplied as Pasted text.txt
brief.status: Idea inventory and prior-work leads; historical narrative and market claims checked separately; not empirical demand evidence.

sources.title: Liberty Media 2025 financial and operating results
sources.read: F1 revenue, categories, team payments and one-time movie income paragraphs.
sources.supports: 2025 F1 revenue about USD 3.9 billion; media 31.3%, sponsorship 21.7%, race promotion 26.7%, other 20.3%.
sources.limits: Issuer disclosure of an established property; central operation, not the entire racing economy. Revenue mix includes exceptional movie income; margins and audience do not transfer to the Moon.

sources.title: Two Circles, Sports IP Revenue League 2026
sources.read: Pages 2-4 and 16, aggregate estimate, ranking and de-duplication methodology; original authored report hosted by ESB.
sources.supports: USD 174 billion sports-property receipts in 2025; NFL central revenue USD 14.9 billion. Internal distributions excluded, annualized and standardized to USD.
sources.limits: Consultancy estimates from public disclosures, not national-account value added or a lunar market. NFL central revenue is not league-plus-club turnover.

sources.title: World Economic Forum, The sports economy: What is it and how could it improve the health of both people and planet?
sources.read: Publisher summary dated 15 January 2026, aggregate revenue and scope.
sources.supports: Broad sports economy estimate USD 2.3 trillion annually, including participation and tourism.
sources.limits: The underlying Sports for People and Planet PDF timed out twice. Its detailed category figures remain unverified here and are not used; publisher summary supports only the aggregate and broad scope.

sources.title: Newzoo, 2026 Global games market key numbers
sources.supports: USD 213.9 billion forecast games revenue for 2026.
sources.limits: Forecast, not realized receipts; all games, not esports or sports games. Export date attribution to November is not the page publication date.

sources.title: BEA, Gross output and value added by industry
sources.read: Complete short definition and kayak example.
sources.supports: Value added equals output minus domestic and imported intermediate inputs; wages remain part of value added.
sources.limits: Definition only; this study omits inventory changes and product taxes, and calculates a narrow producer boundary.

sources.title: K. Elliott Cramer, NASA Advanced NDE Needs to Enable Deep Space Exploration
sources.read: Title and communications slide, PDF page 28 (index 27).
sources.supports: About 1.28 seconds one-way Earth-Moon light-time at the stated distance.
sources.limits: Propagation minimum; relay, coding, buffering and networks add delay. No commercial bandwidth/cost claim.
